messages:

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T15:02:00Z
Subject: Post-call: OrbitHealth - usage & pricing next steps

Hi Tim — great to meet you and Alyssa on today's call. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

Summary of what we heard:
- Primary use: clinical notes summarization + triage prompts for routing (real-time chat + bulk nightly embedding jobs)
- Expected avg prompt length: ~350 tokens; response avg: ~450 tokens (so ~800 tokens / interaction)
- Current expected Q3 volume: 8M interactions/month (variable across pilot) => ~6.4B tokens/month
- Latency requirement: p95 < 600ms for chat; batch embedding jobs can be queued overnight

Ask for next week:
1) Can you confirm the target production volume range (low/expected/high) for the pilot? We used the 2-8M interactions/mo range on the call.
2) What budget range are you planning for inference (monthly)? If you have a target $/1M tokens number that helps us align recommendations.
3) If possible, please share a small sample of real usage logs (anonymized) so Monica can tune the cost model.

I've attached our initial pricing calculator (orbithealth_pricing_calc_v1.xlsx) and a token breakdown template (token_breakdown.csv). Monica will build the invoice estimate once you confirm volumes.

Next steps (our side):
- Monica: run cost modeling for the three volume scenarios and propose unit economics (target $/1M tokens) and an invoice estimate.
- Rachel: prepare SOW / procurement checklist and sample PO language for your procurement team.

Timing: aiming to share an initial estimate by 2027-05-22.

Thanks again — feel free to reply inline or drop a calendar invite for a 20-min follow-up.

Best,
Sean Gallagher

Sean — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers inline: 

1) Volume ranges (pilot -> prod):
- Low: 1M interactions/mo (~800M tokens)
- Expected: 4M interactions/mo (~3.2B tokens)
- High: 10M interactions/mo (~8B tokens)

2) Budget: We're targeting a monthly inference budget in the ~$18k - $65k range for the pilot-to-prod ramp. For planning, we'd like to see a target around $2,200 per 1M tokens (this is what our finance team used in a previous vendor RFP).

3) Attached is a small anonymized usage sample for March (usage_sample_q1.csv). It includes timestamps, prompt/response token counts and endpoint tags. Hope this helps Monica's model.

Also — procurement asked if you can provide an itemized invoice estimate and include any one-time onboarding/setup fees.

Thanks,

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-21T14:10:00Z
Subject: OrbitHealth - initial invoice & unit economics (attached)

Hi Tim — thanks for the sample and the ranges. I ran three scenarios in the attached calculator and summarized the unit economics below. Please see the attached PDF estimate for line-item invoice and assumptions.

Key assumptions (model):
- Model: rwd-llama-7b (quantized) for chat; rwd-embed-1024 for embeddings
- Avg tokens/interaction: 800
- Token split: 44% prompt / 56% response (based on your sample)
- On-demand vs reserved: 70% reserved capacity (discount applied), 30% burst on hosted

Unit economics (per 1M tokens):
- Cost to OrbitHealth (inference + infra + ops): $1,150 / 1M tokens (expected scenario)
- Redwood list price (hosted) before volume discount: $2,600 / 1M tokens
- Proposed negotiated price for pilot (includes reserved commit): $2,050 / 1M tokens

Monthly estimates for the three scenarios:
- Low (0.8B tokens): Redwood estimate = $1,640 (this line looks off - internal note: ensure calculator units)
- Expected (3.2B tokens): Proposed = ~$6,560 (see attached invoice for breakdown)
- High (8B tokens): Proposed = ~$16,400

One-time onboarding/setup: $8,500 (includes SSO/KMS integration assistance, security review time).

Attachments:
- orbithealth_estimate_20270522.pdf (PDF, line-item invoice and assumptions)
- Updated calculator: orbithealth_pricing_calc_v1.xlsx (updated sheet)

Notes/questions:
- Tim: can procurement confirm whether a reserved-capacity commit is feasible for the pilot (even 3-month minimum)? That materially improves unit economics.
- Rachel: can you prepare SOW + sample PO language once Tim confirms budget/commit cadence?

Happy to hop on a quick call to walk through the calc.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
